$artifact: ui-tokenizer — coverage spine for a design system, expressed in the naming law
$note_on_schema_key: v3.0.0 used `$schema` to hold a prose title. Editors resolve that key as a JSON Schema URI and report a load failure, so the prose moved to `$artifact`.
$what_this_is: The COMPLETENESS INDEX of the cookbook, not a value catalogue.
Each key below is a SITUATION ('the background of the secondary button on hover').
Each value is the answer the law gives that situation — the token name.
Answering 'what value is it?' is the target project's job, in its own token file.
Reading rule: key = situacao (cookbook column 1), value = token pela lei (column 3).

$law.source_of_truth: docs/law/GRAMMAR.md — §4.1 entities, §4.2 anatomy, §4.3 properties, §4.4 variants, §4.5 states
$law.state_omission: An omitted state means default. Writing .default is forbidden (§4.5).
$law.property_omission: Anatomy that permits exactly one PAINT property omits it: button.label, field.placeholder, menu.divider (§7.2). A geometry or type property is never implied and is always written: button.label.font-weight.
$law.variant_position: The variant qualifies the ENTITY, never the property: button.secondary.border-color, never button.border-color.secondary (§6, ORDER CORRECTED 2026-08-01).

$forbidden.one_way_rule: surface, semantic, content, label and foreground are SOURCE, never TARGET. They may appear only inside an old_name field — never as the name of a key, family, section, variable or concept (GRAMMAR.md §3, §3.1 and the FRAMING extension of 2026-07-31).
$forbidden.generic_layer_names: layer1..layerN, deep, raised, sunken, canvas, panel — they carry no information and wear a semantic costume (§2). A layer is an elevation METADATA, never a name.
$forbidden.raw_pigment_as_head: pink, green, blue, red, yellow — legal only inside the primitive ramps of 04_COLORS, which are never consumed directly and never head a token (§5.5).
$forbidden.rank_as_head: primary, secondary, tertiary alone. A rank is a variant of an entity, not an entity.

$provenance.descends_from: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max (MIT, 112k stars) via the v3.0.0 AppA template
$provenance.verdict: docs/law/2026-08-01-ui-ux-pro-max-o-que-serve.md — COMPLEMENTAR: it answers VALUE, we answer NAME
adopted: the coverage spine: 24 sections as the matrix entity x variant x size x state
the interaction-state checklist: every interactive entity declares default/hover/active/focus/disabled, or says why not
the container/label pair as a checklist (its X + On X, Material lineage)
the old-name -> law-name bridge, which is the cookbook's migration column
rejected: its vocabulary: surface, on-surface, semantic tokens, danger, accent, tertiary. A 112k-star source recommending the words we ban is DATA, not authority.
its ownerless tier: --color-primary scores 35/100 in our oracle (NO OWNER)
its organising axis (business vertical) instead of physical entity
$provenance.licence: MIT. Nothing of its CODE has been ported to date; only structure. A future port carries a credit header and a NOTICE entry.

$validation.every_dotted_value_is_a_token: Any value matching entity[.segment]+ is submitted to the same oracle that judges a production token.
$validation.expected: score 100 for every one of them — an exception without a written reason is a failure, not a licence.
$validation.measured_on_2026-08-01: 550 token-shaped values, 370 distinct, 550 at score 100, 0 rejected — judged by scoreName with the vocabulary read from GRAMMAR.md. 272 of the 370 are names the cookbook already teaches; the other 98 are geometry and type names that only became legal when §4.3 gained spacing and typography.
$validation.gap_no_executable_guard: There is no validate-template.mjs yet. validate-cookbook.mjs judges cookbook.md, and ds-naming-law.py scans source, CSS and DTCG token files — neither reads this file. Until one exists, the numbers above were produced by an ad-hoc run and this file can drift back exactly as v3.0.0 did.
$validation.law_gap_marker: A value starting with $law-gap: is a situation the law cannot name yet. It is DECLARED, never guessed (§5 rule 5).

01_LAYOUT.$description: Structural decisions. Since 2026-08-01 geometry properties (padding, margin, gap, row-gap, column-gap, border-radius) are IN the law (§4.3), so most of this section now has real token names.

breakpoints.$description: Viewport widths at which the layout changes. A breakpoint is a MEASUREMENT, not a token — it has no entity and paints nothing.

grid.$description: Page-level grid. Column count and max width are measurements; the gutter is a real gap property owned by the page.
grid.max_width: TODO: e.g., 1440px (measurement — no CSS property in §4.3 names a max-width)

max_widths.$description: Width ceilings per region. Renamed from the v3 key 'content_areas' — the word is banned as a family name (§3.1 FRAMING).
max_widths.$note: max-width is not a §4.3 property, so these stay measurements. They are listed here because the coverage spine asks 'did you decide the page's measure?'.

sidebar.breakpoint_collapse: TODO: at what breakpoint does the sidebar collapse? e.g., lg

spacing_scale.$description: The primitive spacing ramp. PRIMITIVE TIER: raw multiples of a base unit, referenced by the tokens below, never typed in a component.

spacing_tokens.$description: Spacing by ENTITY. Renamed from the v3 key 'semantic_spacing' — the word named an architectural tier and is banned as a name (§3).
spacing_tokens.$note: Each of these aliases one step of spacing_scale. The entity is what makes the decision reviewable: 'the card is tighter' is a change to card.padding, not to a global number.
spacing_tokens.$law_gap_density: $law-gap: card_padding_compact / card_padding_spacious and the three button sizes are a DENSITY axis. §4.4 variants are roles (primary..info), not sizes, so 'compact', 'spacious', 'sm', 'md', 'lg' have no slot. Same family as the pending decision in cookbook.md (LAW GAP: variants outside the closed §4.4 vocabulary). Owner decision: amend §4.4 with a size axis, or keep density outside the token system.

aspect_ratios.$description: Measurements for media containers. aspect-ratio is not a §4.3 property.

02_TYPOGRAPHY.$description: Two different things live here. The type SCALE is a primitive ramp (a measurement). The type DECISIONS of each entity are tokens, because font-weight, line-height and letter-spacing entered §4.3 on 2026-08-01.

font_families.secondary: TODO: a second family, or 'same as primary'
font_families.monospace: TODO: for code, ids, aligned figures. e.g., 'JetBrains Mono'
font_families.display: TODO: for hero text, or 'same as primary'

type_scale.$description: Primitive ramp: size + lineHeight + letterSpacing + weight per step. An entity REFERENCES a step; it does not restate the numbers.

heading_3.$use: Card titles, dialog titles, panel headers

heading_4.$use: Sub-section titles, accordion headers, tab labels

heading_5.$use: Small section headers, sidebar group titles, stat labels

heading_6.$use: Smallest heading, column headers, form section titles

body_small.$use: Dense areas, table cells, sidebar items

label.$use: Form labels, button text, badge text, nav items

type_tokens.$description: Type decisions that belong to an entity. These are real tokens: §4.3 carries font-weight, line-height and letter-spacing since 2026-08-01.
type_tokens.$note: A paint property is implied by a text anatomy and omitted (button.label); a TYPE property never is, so it is always written (§7.2, SCOPED 2026-08-01).
type_tokens.$law_gap_font_size: $law-gap: font-size and font-family are NOT in §4.3 — the sixteen properties are seven paint, six geometry and three type, and size/family are in none of them. Every size decision therefore lives in type_scale above as a primitive step. Owner decision: extend §4.3 with font-size/font-family, or keep the scale-reference model.

foreground_colors.$description: The v3 key 'text_colors' is the exact defect §3.1 bans: primary/secondary/tertiary is a RANK axis and success/error/link is a ROLE axis, in one flat family with no entity.
foreground_colors.$measured: content-primary had 1,647 uses across 26 different entities — changing the button's text changed the modal, the card and the field (GRAMMAR.md §3.1).
foreground_colors.$rule: There is no global text-colour token. Each entity owns its own text.
foreground_colors.$law_gap_link: $law-gap: a hyperlink has no entity in §4.1 and 'visited' has no state in §4.5. citation is the closest listed entity but a link inside prose is not a citation. Owner decision: admit a 'link' entity with call-site evidence (§5.5 admission rule), or resolve links as markdown.foreground-color.

text_decoration.underline: TODO: 'none' | 'underline' | 'underline on hover only' (text-decoration is not a §4.3 property — this is a rule, not a token)
text_decoration.strikethrough: TODO: where struck-through text appears (pricing, deleted rows)

text_truncation.$description: Overflow behaviour in constrained space. A rule, not a token.
text_truncation.single_line: TODO: e.g., truncate with an ellipsis
text_truncation.tooltip_on_truncate: TODO: true/false — reveal the full string on hover?

03_NUMBERS.$description: How figures are rendered. Formatting is a rule; the colour of a figure is a token owned by the entity that renders it — usually stat or data-table.

currency_full.type_step: TODO: a step of type_scale (e.g., heading_4)

number_tokens.$description: The colour of a figure. Direction (gain/loss) maps onto the §4.4 roles success and destructive; there is no separate 'positive/negative' axis in the law.

number_indicators.$description: The glyph beside a figure. Icon CHOICE is a rule; icon COLOUR is the token in the same row above.

stat_display.$description: Renamed from 'kpi_display' — stat is the §4.1 entity for a single measured figure.
stat_display.value_type_step: TODO: a step of type_scale (e.g., heading_3)
stat_display.unit_position: TODO: prefix for currency, suffix for percentage

04_COLORS.$description: Two tiers, and the difference is the whole point. PRIMITIVE ramps are raw pigment and are never consumed by a component. ROLE tokens are law names and are the only thing a component may type.

primitive_ramps.$rule: A pigment name is legal HERE and nowhere else. It may never head a token (§5.5) and never appear in a class, a custom property, or a component.
primitive_ramps.$description: Fill hex values for the LIGHT theme first; other themes adapt these.

success.softest: TODO: e.g., #ECFDF5 (the tint behind a success banner)

extended.$use: Extra hues for charts and categories, never for roles

primitive_ramps.renamed_from_v3: the family 'semantic' (a tier name, banned by §3) became these ramps; 'error' became 'destructive', the word §4.4 actually carries; the per-ramp 'surface' key became 'softest'.

elevation_migration.$description: The v3 blocks background_layers / border_layers / text_layers / hover_layers are the defect §2 is about. layer5 and surface.deep carry the SAME information — none — and were consumed by entities that share no role.
elevation_migration.$rule: Elevation is METADATA of a value, never a name. The entity that renders the pixel is the name.

background.old_name: background.layer3 (#F7F7F7) — nested block inside a card

elevation_migration.$warning: One old layer maps to MANY law names — that is the point, not an accident. Two entities that share a hex today are still two contracts (§5 rule 1). The single law name listed per row is the FIRST consumer to migrate; the cookbook holds the full list per situation.

focus_ring.$description: A cross-cutting decision with no parent component — a legitimate global entity under §5.5. One token, N consumers, instead of button.outline-color.focus + field.outline-color.focus + ...
focus_ring.$law_gap_geometry: $law-gap: outline-width and outline-offset are not in §4.3 (which carries outline-color only). They stay measurements until the owner extends the property list.

selection.$description: A selected row/item. selected is a real §4.5 state, so this is a state token on the entity that is selected — never a global 'selection' colour.

chart_palettes.$description: Ordered sequences for data series. These are VALUES indexed by position, not roles.
chart_palettes.$law_gap: $law-gap: a cyclic N-slot palette has no token model — DTCG models one token, not an array, and a series index is not a §4.4 variant. Registered in cookbook.md (LAW GAP: 'Paleta cíclica indexada para N valores dinâmicos'). Until the owner decides, a chart series is resolved at implementation level, not by a token per slot.

categorical.$use: Distinct series, up to 8-10 visually separable

sequential.$use: One metric, low to high (heat maps, density)

diverging.$use: Negative to positive around a midpoint

financial.$use: Domain series with a fixed meaning

domain_categories.$description: Colour that identifies a BUSINESS CATEGORY, not a UI role. Renamed from 'data_status' and 'segment_colors'.
domain_categories.$law_gap: $law-gap: §4.4 has seven roles of severity/emphasis and no slot for a category enum. Mapping active->success or overdue->destructive would be INFERENCE from the hue, which §5 rule 5 forbids. Registered in cookbook.md (LAW GAP: 'Categorias de domínio sem papel de severidade') with the same pending owner decision: give the law a named-category mechanism, or resolve categories at implementation level with an explicit map.

05_ICONOGRAPHY.$description: icon is an ANATOMY (§4.2), never an entity. There is no global icon colour: an icon is always some entity's icon.
05_ICONOGRAPHY.icon_library: TODO: which set? e.g., 'Lucide React', 'Heroicons', 'custom SVGs'
05_ICONOGRAPHY.fallback_library: TODO: secondary set when the primary lacks a glyph

sizes.xs: KEEP: 12px (w-3 h-3) — inline with caption text, status dots
sizes.sm: KEEP: 16px (w-4 h-4) — inline with body text, button icons, table actions
sizes.md: TODO: e.g., 20px (w-5 h-5) — navigation items, field icons
sizes.lg: KEEP: 24px (w-6 h-6) — standalone icons, card headers, toolbar
sizes.xl: TODO: e.g., 32px (w-8 h-8) — feature icons, empty states
sizes.2xl: TODO: e.g., 48px (w-12 h-12) — hero icons, onboarding

icon_tokens.$description: One row per entity that renders an icon. The v3 block 'icon_colors' had a single global default/muted/active family — the ownerless pattern §3.1 bans.

icon_containers.$description: The coloured disc or square behind an icon. The container is the ENTITY's icon background, not a component of its own.

fallback.$description: What renders when there is no image.
fallback.background_generation: TODO: 'hash from name' (stable per person) or 'random from palette'
fallback.fallback_palette: $law-gap: an index-into-N palette, the same gap as chart_palettes above — a slot per person has no token model. List the hexes in the primitive ramps and select at implementation level.

status_indicator.$description: The presence dot. on and off are real §4.5 states; busy and away are not.
status_indicator.$law_gap_presence: $law-gap: 'busy' and 'away' are presence values with no state in §4.5, and they are not severity roles either. Same family as the domain_categories gap. Owner decision required before they get a name.
status_indicator.ring_width: TODO: e.g., 2px (contrast ring around the dot)

07_BORDERS.$description: border-color is paint; border-radius is geometry. Both are §4.3 properties, so both are nameable.

width.$note: border-width is NOT in §4.3. These stay measurements.

style.$note: border-style is not in §4.3 either — a rule, not a token.

radius_tokens.$description: border-radius entered §4.3 on 2026-08-01, so a corner is now a real token instead of a raw class.

dividers.$description: The hairline. A cross-cutting decision, so it is the global entity divider (§5.5) — one token, N consumers, instead of menu.divider + data-table.divider + modal.divider for one decision.

08_SHADOWS.$description: box-shadow IS a §4.3 paint property, so a shadow is a token like any other. The ramp below is primitive; the tokens reference it.

shadow_tokens.old_name: shadow.secondary (v3.0.0, 'secondary buttons') — a shadow named after a variant with no entity; it is button.box-shadow, and if it really is variant-specific, button.secondary.box-shadow

09_LOGO.$description: logo is a §4.1 entity. Most rows here are brand rules rather than tokens.

variants.$note: These are ASSET variants, not §4.4 role variants — they never enter a token name.

09_LOGO.clear_space: TODO: minimum breathing room (e.g., the height of the mark)
09_LOGO.backgrounds_allowed: TODO: which backgrounds may carry the logo?

10_BUTTONS.$description: The reference entity. Every variant here is a §4.4 role and every state a §4.5 state — nothing invented.

variants.$vocabulary: §4.4 closed list: primary, secondary, ghost, destructive, success, warning, info
variants.old_name: types.primary|secondary|tertiary|danger (v3.0.0). 'danger' is 'destructive' in the law; 'tertiary' has no slot at all.
variants.$law_gap_tertiary: $law-gap: 'tertiary', 'outline', 'link', 'subtle', 'accent' and the four soft variants are used in real code and are outside §4.4. Enumerated with path:line in cookbook.md chapter 1 (LAW GAP block). Owner decision: amend §4.4, or fold each one into a listed role.

states.$checklist: Every interactive entity declares these five, or says why one does not exist. Adopted from ui-ux-pro-max; expressed in §4.5 vocabulary.
states.$note: Figma and much source code call the pressed state 'Press'. The law says active. loading is also a §4.5 state and applies wherever the button can be busy.
states.old_name: states: [default, hover, press, focus, disabled] (v3.0.0 — 'press' is not a §4.5 state)

anatomy.$description: A button has more than one addressable part, so anatomy is written (§4.2). label and icon are single-paint-property anatomies, so the paint property is omitted (§7.2).
anatomy.label: button.primary.text

sizes.$note: Density is not a §4.4 axis — see the law gap in 01_LAYOUT.spacing_tokens. Sizes stay measurements until the owner rules.

icon_button.$description: A button whose only child is an icon. Same entity, same tokens — the label is simply absent.

button_group.shared_radius: TODO: e.g., 8px on the outer corners only

loading_state.label: button.primary.text.loading
loading_state.$law_gap_loader: $law-gap: the spinner inside a button is a third part next to label and icon, and §4.2 lists neither 'loader' nor 'spinner'. Measured in the Figma extraction (DESIGN_TOKENS/10-buttons.json:134-141, a distinct loaderColor) and registered in cookbook.md chapter 1.

10_BUTTONS.$law_gap_opacity: $law-gap: the disabled state is implemented with opacity in real code (disabled:opacity-50; 0.4 in the other product) and 'opacity' is not a §4.3 property. Registered in cookbook.md chapter 1.

11_FILTERS.$description: A filter bar is a toolbar; a filter chip is a pill; the active-count badge is a badge. All three are §4.1 entities.

filter_bar.position: TODO: sticky below the nav, or inline in the page?

filter_chip.$description: Renamed to the pill entity. The three v3 'states' map onto §4.5 exactly: default / selected / hover.
filter_chip.type_step: TODO: a step of type_scale (e.g., label_small)

12_NAVIGATION.$description: sidebar, nav-item and toolbar are §4.1 entities. Tabs, breadcrumbs and pagination are NOT — they are declared gaps, not guesses.

nav_item.$checklist: the five interaction states, in §4.5 vocabulary
nav_item.label: nav-item.color

topbar.$description: A horizontal bar of controls across the top. Resolved as toolbar — the §4.1 entity for a strip of controls.

tabs.$law_gap: $law-gap: 'tab' is not in §4.1 and the cookbook has no situation for it in 712 measured rows. nav-item is the nearest listed entity but a tab switches a panel inside a page while a nav-item navigates — different contracts. Admitting an entity requires call-site evidence in the same change (§5.5). Do not name a tab until then.
tabs.underline_when_selected: $law-gap: same gap — the indicator has no entity to hang from.

breadcrumbs.$law_gap: $law-gap: no entity in §4.1, no situation in the cookbook. Same admission rule as tabs.

pagination.$law_gap: $law-gap: no entity in §4.1. It also appears in real code as a button variant named 'pagination', itself a §4.4 gap registered in cookbook.md chapter 1.

13_FORMS.$description: field, select, checkbox, radio, toggle and slider are §4.1 entities. Note field.placeholder and field.helper omit the paint property (§7.2).

text_field.$checklist: the five interaction states, plus invalid, which is a real §4.5 state
text_field.label: field.text
text_field.$law_gap_readonly: $law-gap: 'readonly' is not a §4.5 state. Nearest legal expression is disabled, but the two differ (readonly is focusable and copyable). Owner decision before it gets a name.
text_field.$law_gap_disabled_opacity: $law-gap: the disabled field is drawn with opacity 0.5 in the source template and opacity is not a §4.3 property — same gap as 10_BUTTONS.

textarea.$description: Same entity as text_field, different geometry.

checkbox.$law_gap_indeterminate: $law-gap: 'indeterminate' is a real tri-state of a checkbox and is not in §4.5 (which has checked, on, off). Owner decision.

date_picker.$law_gap: $law-gap: a calendar has no entity in §4.1 and no situation in the cookbook. Its TRIGGER is a field and its PANEL is a popover — those two parts are nameable today; the grid of days is not.
date_picker.selected_day: $law-gap: no entity for a day cell
date_picker.range_fill: $law-gap: no entity for a day range

file_upload.$description: The uploaded item IS the §4.1 entity attachment. The drop zone that receives it is not.
file_upload.dropzone: $law-gap: a drop zone has no entity in §4.1 and no situation in the cookbook. empty-state is the nearest listed entity but a drop zone is an input, not an absence of data.

form_layout.required_indicator: TODO: e.g., '*' after the label, coloured field.helper.invalid

14_CARDS.$description: card is a §4.1 entity; stat is the entity for a single measured figure inside one.

variants.$note: flat / elevated / outlined / interactive are ELEVATION and BEHAVIOUR, not §4.4 roles. They are expressed by WHICH property the card sets, not by a variant segment.

role_variants.$note: these ARE §4.4 roles and do enter the name

variants.old_name: variants.flat|elevated|outlined|interactive (v3.0.0) — kept as GROUPING labels here, never as a token segment

card_header.title: card.header.color
card_header.title_type_step: TODO: a step of type_scale (e.g., heading_5)

stat_card.$description: Renamed from kpi_card — stat is the §4.1 entity.
stat_card.label: stat.text

15_CHARTS.$description: chart is a §4.1 entity, and a chart tooltip is the tooltip entity. Its internal furniture (axis, gridline, legend) has no anatomy in §4.2 — declared, not guessed.

general.font_family: TODO: primary, or monospace for axis figures

series.$note: A series with a ROLE (loss, target breached) uses a §4.4 variant. A series that is merely the third one in an arbitrary list does not — see the chart_palettes law gap in 04_COLORS.

axis.$law_gap: $law-gap: 'axis', 'tick' and 'gridline' are not in §4.2 and the cookbook has no situation for them. The nearest legal name for a gridline is the global divider.border-color, but a gridline is drawn by the chart, not a separator between blocks — asserting the equivalence would be a guess (§5 rule 5).

legend.$description: The legend's TEXT belongs to the block that carries it, usually the card.
legend.swatch: $law-gap: a legend swatch shows a series colour; it has no anatomy of its own in §4.2 and inherits the chart_palettes gap.

pie_donut.inner_radius_ratio: TODO: e.g., 0.6 for a donut, 0 for a pie

16_TABLES.$description: data-table is a §4.1 entity with header, row, cell, thumb, handle and divider as anatomy. list-row is a separate entity for a non-tabular list.

row.$checklist: default / hover / selected are all real §4.5 states
row.$law_gap_striped: $law-gap: zebra striping ('even' / 'odd') is a POSITION in a list, and position answers no §4 slot — the same reason 'layer' is banned. Owner decision: leave striping to implementation, or admit a positional axis.

cell.type_step: TODO: a step of type_scale (e.g., body_small)
cell.number_font: TODO: monospace for aligned decimals, or the same as body

list_row.$description: A non-tabular row (inbox, results, settings list). Separate §4.1 entity.
list_row.label: list-row.text

17_MODALS_POPUPS.$description: modal, drawer, popover, tooltip, menu and overlay are all §4.1 entities. backdrop is a single-paint anatomy, so modal.backdrop omits the property (§7.2).

confirmation_dialog.$description: A destructive confirmation is the modal entity carrying the destructive role.
confirmation_dialog.title: modal.destructive.header.color

drawer.$description: A side panel. Its scrim is the overlay entity.
drawer.animation: TODO: e.g., slideIn from the right, 300ms

menu.$description: The list of actions inside a popover. Distinct §4.1 entity because its rows have their own contract.

overlay.$description: The generic scrim behind anything that overlays the page.
overlay.label: overlay.text

18_BANNERS_MESSAGING.$description: toast, banner, empty-state, skeleton and progress are §4.1 entities. Their intents are §4.4 roles, so no new vocabulary is needed.

toast.old_name: toast.intents.error (v3.0.0) — the law's word for that role is destructive

inline_alert.$description: A non-dismissable message inside the page. Same entity as banner.
inline_alert.$note: The v3 'subtle' vs 'solid' pair is an EMPHASIS axis, not a role. Both spellings resolve to the same token per role; the value differs, the name does not.

banner.$description: A full-width strip at the top of a page or section.

loading.$law_gap_spinner: $law-gap: a free-standing spinner has no entity in §4.1 and no anatomy in §4.2 — the same gap as the in-button loader in 10_BUTTONS. A determinate bar is progress and is fully named above; an indeterminate spinner is not.
loading.$law_gap_skeleton_shine: $law-gap: the moving highlight of a skeleton is a gradient in motion, not one background-color. Same class as the animated text gradient registered in cookbook.md chapter 1.

19_TRANSITIONS_ANIMATIONS.$description: Motion has no property in §4.3 — the sixteen are seven paint, six geometry and three type. Everything here is therefore a MEASUREMENT or a rule, declared as such rather than dressed as a token.
19_TRANSITIONS_ANIMATIONS.$law_gap: $law-gap: transition-duration, transition-timing-function and animation-name are not §4.3 properties, so motion cannot be named entity.property today. Owner decision: extend §4.3 with a motion domain (a fourth alongside paint, geometry and type), or keep motion outside the token grammar.

motion_patterns.slide_right: TODO: translateX(-100% to 0) — the drawer entering
motion_patterns.scale_in: TODO: scale(0.95 to 1) — the modal entering
motion_patterns.collapse: TODO: an accordion; animate grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr, never display

reduced_motion.strategy: TODO: 'instant' (all durations to 0ms) or 'fade-only' (opacity changes only)

20_ACCESSIBILITY.$description: Rules and thresholds. Only the focus ring is a token, and it is the global entity focus-ring (§5.5).

focus.never_remove_outline: RULE: outline:none always needs a visible replacement
focus.tab_order: RULE: tab order must match visual order
focus.$note: One decision, N consumers. Writing button.outline-color.focus + field.outline-color.focus + select.outline-color.focus is N copies of a single global decision — the defect §5.5 was opened to fix.

colour_independence.$rule: Information must never be carried by colour alone.

21_OPACITY_SCALE.$description: A primitive ramp. opacity is NOT a §4.3 property, which is why the disabled states above are declared law gaps rather than named.
21_OPACITY_SCALE.$law_gap: $law-gap: opacity is used in production for the disabled state (disabled:opacity-50 in one product, 0.4 in the other) and has no slot in §4.3. Registered in cookbook.md chapter 1. Owner decision: add opacity to §4.3, or require disabled states to declare explicit colours.

22_Z_INDEX_SCALE.$description: Stacking order. This is exactly the METADATA §1 says must live in one place and never be typed into a name — z-position is the question `surface` was answering when it was banned (§7.2).

23_ANTI_PATTERNS.$description: Things never to do. The v3 list taught theme.background.layer1 as the CORRECT answer — the exact vocabulary this law bans. Rewritten against the law.
naming: NEVER use surface, semantic or content in a token name, a class, a custom property, a variable, a report section or an artifact name. They may appear only as an old name being eliminated (§3, §3.1, FRAMING extension).
NEVER name a token after its elevation (layer1, deep, raised, canvas, panel). Elevation is metadata; the entity that renders the pixel is the name (§2).
NEVER head a token with a rank (primary) or a raw pigment (pink). The head must be an entity you can point at on screen (§5.5).
NEVER write .default. An omitted state IS the default (§4.5).
NEVER put the variant after the property. button.secondary.border-color, never button.border-color.secondary — the middle prefix of the second form promises a token that does not exist (§6).
NEVER emit more than one utility family from one token. A token declares ONE property; text-page painting text with the page BACKGROUND value is defect H-021 (§6).
NEVER infer an entity from a hex value. Two entities sharing a colour today are still two contracts (§5 rule 1).
NEVER invent a name for an ambiguous case. Mark it PENDING with the reason (§5 rule 5).
colors: NEVER hardcode a hex in a component. Reference the token.
NEVER consume a primitive ramp directly. A component types a role token; only a role token may reference a primitive.
NEVER use a generic utility palette class (bg-neutral-200) for a themed decision.
typography: NEVER skip heading levels (h1 to h3 with no h2).
NEVER use a near-white grey for body text (contrast).
NEVER let a line exceed roughly 75 characters.
icons: NEVER use an emoji as an icon. SVG only.
NEVER size icons ad hoc — always a step of the icon size scale.
NEVER give an icon a global colour. An icon is always some entity's icon (§4.2).
interaction: NEVER rely on hover alone (it does not exist on touch).
NEVER use outline:none without a visible replacement.
NEVER omit cursor:pointer on a clickable element.
NEVER declare a state token without its default pair — hover with no base is the zero-delta defect (§5 rule 4).
layout: NEVER use an arbitrary spacing value; reference the scale.
NEVER use a magic z-index; reference 22_Z_INDEX_SCALE.
NEVER cause horizontal scroll at any viewport.
NEVER disable zoom in the viewport meta.
animation: NEVER animate width or height; animate transform.
data: NEVER show a raw number unformatted; use a locale-aware formatter.
NEVER convey meaning by colour alone; pair it with an icon or a label.

24_PRE_DELIVERY_CHECKLIST.$description: Verify before calling a component or page done.
naming: Every new token parses as entity[.variant][.anatomy][.property][.state] with no leftover segment
Every new token scores 100 in score-naming.mjs, or an exception is written down with its reason
No new use of surface, semantic or content — ds-naming-law.py exits 0 against the baseline
Every state token has its default pair declared next to it
Every prefix agrees with the property spelled in the name (prefix-property, baseline 0)
Any situation with no legal name is marked as a law gap with the reason, not guessed
visual: Every colour comes from a token (zero hardcoded hex)
Every spacing comes from the scale, via an entity token
Every radius, shadow and z-index references its scale
Every font size and weight matches a type_scale step
The component holds up in every theme the product ships
interaction: The five states are declared: default, hover, active, focus, disabled (plus loading where it applies)
Focus is visible and comes from focus-ring, not from a per-entity copy
accessibility: Every icon-only button has an aria-label
Every input has an associated label
responsive: No horizontal scroll at any of them
At least 16px body text on mobile
performance: Transitions animate transform and opacity only
evidence: The claim is backed by a rendered before/after, not by a code diff
The console comparison shows no new error
The migration ledger entry is complete, with commands and raw output
